summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes 727KB obfuscated Bun payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall`: `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (_0xNNNN variable/string-array indirection) and, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime archive from GitHub releases (`https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip`) into an OS temp directory, chmods the extracted binary executable, and invokes it with `execFileSync` to run the sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line file tagged `// @bun @bun-cjs`, containing a char-code / `fromCodePoint` string table and a rotating string-decoder (`WV8StW`) — a heavily obfuscated payload with no source, sourcemap, or README reference. The package advertises itself as a React/CSS feature-highlight UI component and has no build-time need for a second language runtime or an opaque bundled blob. The Bun-runtime invocation path also evades Node-focused install-time analyzers, since the payload never runs under Node.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
